“and He subjected to you the night and the day and the sun and the…”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 16:12).

486
Explanation from Sufyān No. 486: 3: 11

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
486: 3:11. Sufyan said: The companions of Abd Allah used to recite it
"and He subjected to you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars," and they also recite it "[subjected] by His command" (verse 12) [the source is partly garbled].

486: 3: 11 سفيان قَالَ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يقرؤونها وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ والقمر والنجوم وقد ويقرءونها علي حتى مسخرات بأمره (الآية 12) .

05

“and by the stars they are guided”

An explanation transmitted from Ibrāhīm (Q 16:16).

489
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 489: 6: 8

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
489: 6:8. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
They are the landmarks that are in the sky; "and by the stars they are guided": He said, they are guided at sea on their journeys (verse 16).
العربية
489: 6: 8 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لأنه قَالَ هِيَ الْأَعْلَامُ الَّتِي فِي السماء هم يهتدون قَالَ يَهْتَدُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فِي أسفارهم (الآية 16) .
Edition record 371404 · p. 165Link to report ↗

490
Explanation from al-Ḍaḥḥāk No. 490: 7: 16

al-Ḍaḥḥāk

English
Transmission wording

07

“from it you take intoxicant and good provision”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 16:67).

491
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 491: 8: 1

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
491: 8:1. Sufyan, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Amr ibn Sufyan, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
"from it you take intoxicant and good provision": He said, the intoxicant [sakar] is what is made unlawful from its fruit, and the good provision is what is made lawful from its fruit (verse 67).
العربية
491: 8: 1 سفيان عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ عمرو بن سفيان عن بن عباس في قوله منه سكرا ورزقا حسنا قَالَ السَّكَرُ مَا حُرِّمَ مَنْ ثَمَرَتِهَا وَالرِّزْقُ الْحَسَنُ مَا أُحِلَّ من ثمرتها (الآية 67) .
Edition record 371404 · p. 165Link to report ↗
492
Report from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 492: 9: 5

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
492: 9:5. Sufyan, from Abu Husayn, from Said ibn Jubayr:
"you take from it intoxicant and good provision": He said, the intoxicant is the unlawful and the good provision is the lawful.
العربية
492: 9: 5 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا ورزقا حسنا قَالَ السَّكَرُ الْحَرَامُ وَالرِّزْقُ الْحَسَنُ الحلال.
Edition record 371404 · p. 165Link to report ↗

11

“This one teaches Muhammad, peace be upon him”

Two explanations transmitted from ʿIkrima and Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 16:103).

497
Explanation from ʿIkrima No. 497: 14: 2

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
497: 14:2. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Ikrima, who said:
There was a boy belonging to the Banu Amir ibn Luayy, I think he was called Yaish, or he was one of the People of the Book. Quraysh said, "This one teaches Muhammad, peace be upon him." So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "The tongue of the one they allude to is foreign, while this is a clear Arabic tongue" (verse 103).
العربية
497: 14: 2 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ كَانَ غُلَامٌ لبني عامر ابن لُؤَيٍّ أَظُنُّهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ يَعِيشُ أَوْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فَقَالَتْ قُرَيْشٌ هَذَا يُعَلِّمُ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل لِسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مبين (الآية 103) .
Edition record 371406 · p. 167Link to report ↗
